text:
Elena: Downsizing my desk gear before the move — free Samsung Odyssey G9 49" (5120x1440, 240Hz) curved monitor. Has original stand, DP cable, and a small adhesive nick on the bottom bezel. Pickup SoMa bench F. Pics: https://imgur.com/a/odysseyG9
Marcus: Wow that's huge. Any burn-in? Also does it support 100% sRGB?
Elena: No visible burn-in. I used it for gaming + productivity. Panels report ~95% sRGB after calibration. Works fine with macOS and Windows.
Leah: Interested if it's still available. Can you hold it until Friday noon? I won't be in today.
Jin: If Leah passes, I can take it Friday afternoon and have a pickup van. Heads up these are heavy.
Elena: Holding until Fri 12pm for Leah. If no DM by then it's up for grabs to next person.
ops-bot: Reminder: label items with your name + date and register pickup on the community board. Don't leave items overnight without facilities approval.
Marcus: Also check the stand screws if you plan to transport it — they can loosen. Two-person carry recommended.
Leah: DM sent, thanks. If I can't swing it I'll update here by 11am.
facilities: Bench F reserved Fri 10am-1pm for Elena. Please avoid blocking the corridor.
Jin: If Leah declines I'm happy to help move it. I have moving straps and a cart.
Leah: Claiming it! DM replied with floor + desk. I'll be there at 11:45am. Thanks Elena!
Elena: Thanks all. Leaving the monitor on Bench F with a sticky "HOLD for Leah until Fri 12:00". I'll remove it if unclaimed at 12. :thumbsup:
